statement: A byte string writing 255 -- a value that fits in 1 byte -- with additional-info 25 (a 2-byte argument) is not decoded
deviation: 255's shortest form is the ai=24 form `18 ff`. The ai=25 form `19 00 ff` is 1 byte longer. The scanner's judgement is `v > u8::MAX` -- 255 is the largest value on the false side and 256 is the smallest on the true side. Swapping `>` for `>=` turns this vector into an accept, and swapping for `<` turns the control into a reject.
origin: gx self-authored for the fix hand (req/38 §16 H6-4)

control.note: 256 is the smallest value that does not fit in 1 byte, so the ai=25 form is shortest = accepted
